messages:
Aisha Khan: Heads-up: I9m ready to create the listings for AWS/GCP/Azure tomorrow. Need final confirmation on three items before I click submit: 1) packaging format we9ll reference (container image URIs vs AMI IDs vs GCP marketplace image), 2) cross-account access pattern for artifact retrieval, 3) canonical pricing SKU string. @Tom @Priya

Tom Reynolds: For packaging: prefer container URIs for hosted images, AMI per-region for aws, and a GCE image name for gcp. We should produce a small manifest that has keys: version, build_time, artifacts -> {region: {type, uri, checksum}}. Keep it terse.

Priya Nair: Agree. CI will emit manifest.json and separate .sha256 files. Example gcloud/az/aws commands we use in CI:

```bash
# upload blob for Azure
az storage blob upload --account-name redwoodmarket --container-name artifacts --name myapp-2.0.0.tar.gz --file dist/myapp-2.0.0.tar.gz
sha256sum dist/myapp-2.0.0.tar.gz > dist/myapp-2.0.0.tar.gz.sha256
az storage blob upload --account-name redwoodmarket --container-name artifacts --name myapp-2.0.0.tar.gz.sha256 --file dist/myapp-2.0.0.tar.gz.sha256

# AWS: register AMI and map per region
aws ec2 register-image --name "redwood-myapp-2.0.0" --architecture x86_64 --root-device-name /dev/xvda --virtualization-type hvm --block-device-mappings file://bdm.json
# then capture ami id per region and write to manifest

# GCP: create image
gcloud compute images create redwood-myapp-2-0-0 --source-uri gs://redwood-marketplace/myapp.tar.gz
```

Tom Reynolds: On cross-account access: do NOT give the marketplaces broad S3/Azure blob list perms. Create a short-lived role for AWS (assume-role) and SAS tokens for Azure. For GCP provide a service account with objectViewer only for the specific bucket path. Example AWS IAM trust snippet we use:```json
{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::marketplace-account:role/MarketplaceDeployment"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole","Condition":{}}]}
```

Priya Nair: Also: encrypt artifacts with a CMK and include a grant for the marketplace service principal to Decrypt. We have a standard terraform module: redwood/marketplace-artifact-bucket that wires KMS+role+bucket policy.

Lena Ortiz: Legal: pricing SKU must match the contract. For AWS be careful with metered vs subscription type listings. I'll attach the finalized SKU string in a follow-up. Also need an explicit export-control flag if we plan to block China/HK. If we block regions, mention fallback images (e.g., BYO-license).

Oliver Chen: Ops note: ensure health-check endpoints and readiness probe docs are in the artifact bundle (health.yaml). Marketplace reviewers often hit the endpoint during verification. Add a README with endpoints and sample curl.

publisher-portal-bot: publisher-portal-bot: uploaded manifest.json to publisher-staging bucket (manifest version 2.0.0)

Aisha Khan: Awesome. Action items: Tom to publish role/SAS/SvcAccount runbook by EOD; Priya to add KMS grant + CI job changes; Lena to confirm SKU + export controls; Oliver to add health docs to artifact. If no blockers I9ll open the publisher portal at 10:00 PT tomorrow and submit staging listing.

Priya Nair: I9ll also add a small validation step in CI that verifies manifest mapping covers all target regions and that checksums match uploaded blobs (failing build on mismatch).
